SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Confidential.
Subject (in full) Mrs. T. F. Boulgakova-Belsky.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 43
CENTRAL. I. Branch.
Date February 25, 1929

Made by P.C.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by W. Sireno A. C. Pol.

Information has been received to the effect that
Mrs. T. F. Boulgakova-Belsy alias Bouldakova, communist
and important member of the G.P.U., arrived in Shanghai from
Tientsin some time in December 1928 and stayed at the Plaza
Hotel until February 10, 1929 when she removed to her present
address at 7 Carter Road. It is reported that she was for
a number of years attached to the G.P.U. in Tientsin during
which time she acted as secret courier between Tientsin,
Peking, Mukden and Harbin. A report is also current that
she was arrested in Tientsin for Communist activities, but
this has not been confirmed. It is also reported that while
in Tientsin she was in charge of a number of dancing partners
whose duty it was to disseminate communist propaganda among
foreign troops stationed there. It is possible that this
latter influence also spread to Shanghai.

Mrs. Boulgakova-Belsky frequents the Grill Room of
the Palace Hotel and is in possession of a Soviet passport.
Her husband was formerly Commander-in-Chief of one of the
Soviet armies, which was engaged against the Whites in the
Maritime Province in 1920-1922. He is now reported to be
employed as Assistant Procurator to the G.P.U. in Vladivostock.
Photograph attached.

B. Maklaevsky
P. C. S.

HR.
26/29
A/ D.C.I.

Ref. No. d/February 25, 1929.
Copies to H.B.M.Consul, Col.Halland, Capt.Shelley, Lt. Carlson.

由 P.C.S. 马克拉耶夫斯基（Maklaevsky）撰写。经 W. Sireno A. C. Pol. 转发

收到情报称，T. F. 布尔加科娃-贝尔西夫人（别名布尔达科娃），共产党员及国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）重要成员，于1928年12月某时从天津抵达上海，并入住华懋饭店（Plaza Hotel），直至1929年2月10日搬至现址卡特路（Carter Road）7号。据报，她在天津期间曾为国家政治保卫局工作多年，在此期间，她担任天津、北平、奉天和哈尔滨之间的秘密交通员。另有传闻称她曾因共产主义活动在天津被捕，但此消息尚未得到证实。还据报道，她在天津期间负责管理一批舞伴，其任务是在驻津外国军队中散布共产主义宣传。这种影响有可能也蔓延到了上海。

布尔加科娃-别尔斯基夫人常去宫饭店（Palace Hotel）的烧烤餐厅，并持有苏联护照。她的丈夫曾任苏联一支军队的总司令，该军队于1920-1922年间在滨海省与白军作战。据报他目前受雇于符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）的国家政治保卫局，担任助理检察官。附照片一张。

B. 马克拉耶夫斯基（Maklaevsky）
P. C. S.

HR.
1929年第26号
助理刑事侦缉处长

参考编号 d/1929年2月25日。
